def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background, separator = [v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)]
    marker_rows = sorted({r for r, row in enumerate(grid) for v in row if v not in (background, separator)})
    marker_cols = sorted({c for row in grid for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (background, separator)})
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(marker_rows, marker_rows[1:]):
        row_out = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(marker_cols, marker_cols[1:]):
            corners = [grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]]
            row_out.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 else background)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
